newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African shares rebel against rand to end higher.
newsitem.headline: S.African shares rebel against rand to end higher.

text.p: Rebelling against a weak rand industrial and all-shares held their heads above opening levels to end moderately higher and extend the previous day's climb.
Reinforced by Wednesday's strong march and Wall Street's second record close in a row, shares took courage from the U.S. market's steady open and a stolid local futures market.
But turning to golds, bullion's failed assault on the key $380 an ounce level let the board down.
The overall index ended up 17.4 points at 7,014.5, industrials were up 21.9 points to 8,226.1 and golds were off 9.3 points to 1,722.5.
